footnotes_raw: The treaty allows 50% of limits in the table for facultative cessions.
The Marine Cargo Surplus treaty covers cargos transported by sea, air or land and cover is provided on original basis.
The treaty provides ceding commission of 30% and profit commission of 25% (with management expenses of 10%).
The cash loss limit is the same as the maximum retention NGN50mn and a cash advice of NGN37.5m,
The loss participation requirement appears to have been removed to the company’s advantage.
